title: foss-mcp environment-blocked verification record
description: evidence/build/<gate>/<card>/env_blocked.json. Written ONLY by `gatectl verify` when a card's declared capabilities are missing, so its checks could not be run at all. It is an environment fact, not a code verdict: it never counts against the card's attempt budget, and it is never read as FAIL. It is authoritative only while it is newer than the card's receipt. A later receipt supersedes it, so a fixed environment is never blocked by an old record.
